summary: Batch A migrated. iOS: sign in/up (one layout both size classes, segmented + field card + pinned primary), forgot password, MFA six-box, complete profile, terms re-accept, edit profile, delete account, redeem code, seat steppers, 2FA setup/disable, new agent, timezone picker, devotion wizard restyle; system fonts across Account. Web: SignIn, ForgotPassword, ResetPassword, VerifyMfa, VerifyEmail, TermsGate on kit; Account/Subscription/Payouts/Upgrade via FormSkin theme; Donation modal on kit. Deviations: inline edit-profile keeps inline Save (long page, no pinned bar); devotion wizard keeps its 3-screen nav structure (restyled, not re-ordered into the TA1 stepper); antd surfaces use theme skin instead of full rewrite.
